feature_contract.goal: Complete the RT0 raster-state read-path improvement with one fewer trusted synchronous D3D9 getter while preserving SetRenderTarget implicit viewport/scissor changes, full live fallback, and fail-closed Reset recovery.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R23 game-side RT0 raster state read and its regression gate; no changes to R22 tracked setters, game HUD, F11, ESC, main menu, SkyGlow, stereo resource ownership, FFB, DX11 or DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: At authenticated source HEAD, R23 forced GetViewport/GetScissorRect/GetRenderState on every RT0 setter; R22 already tracks scissor-enable under reliable StateBlock Apply and SetRenderTarget cannot change that render state. New fast path performs two live getters rather than three for trusted RT0. CPU source call-count improvement only; Quest3 p95/p99 and FPS unmeasured.
trace_stages: Game SetRenderTarget RT0 intrinsically resets viewport and can affect scissor rect, so both geometries must be sampled.
R22 StateBlock Apply/setter shadow fences scissor-enable validity while R23 resynchronizes actual viewport and scissor from device.
R23 baseline recovery and R29/R33 stereo replay use shadow to restore actual game geometry before OpenXR host eye composition.
subcomponents: Trust scissor-enable only when R22 snapshot and StateBlock tracking are both valid, while always sampling two device geometry getters on RT0 switches.
Retain original three-getter full capture when Apply/Reset trust is lost; enforce failed-read fail-closed without stale geometry.
Add registered source regression checker with six destructive mutations, 16 state combinations and per-mode fallback call counts.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Trusted RT0 switches update live viewport/scissor and only inherit reliable scissor-enable, eliminating one device getter without impairing game raster state.
Loss of StateBlock reliability or shadow validity uses the previous full three-query capture; failed live geometry reads retain the existing fail-closed stereo recovery.
Registered deterministic mutation checker and exactly matching DX9Ex Active five jobs, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact if triggered; hardware optics/FPS remain UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R23CaptureActualGameState force=true SetRenderTarget invokes R22CaptureGameScissor to retrieve all three raster values even when R22 shadow tracks enable reliably.
diagnosis.root_cause: RenderTarget transitions may implicitly change viewport/scissor geometry but do not change D3DRS_SCISSORTESTENABLE; catch-all forced live state collection redundantly re-reads this trusted bit.
source_trace: OutRun game SetRenderTarget updates RT0, then R23 SetRenderTarget hook samples actual state.
R22 setter and StateBlock generation determine trusted enable; R23 reads changed viewport/scissor and re-publishes corrected shadow.
Downstream R23 clear/mono recovery and R29/R33 eye draws consume the actual game raster shadow.
alternatives_rejected: Caching viewport on RT switches would lose implicit viewport reset and crop game geometry.
Skipping live scissor geometry is unsafe, even when scissor test is currently disabled.
Reusing enable after unreliable Apply or Reset is unsafe; full conservative capture remains the fallback.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: C++ R23 material changes capture live viewport/scissor but inherit scissor enable only under reliable tracked shadow and preserve failure/epoch logic.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Six destructive source mutations guard shadow validity, both geometry getters, full fallback and error handling; positive model enumerates reliability, validity, enable state and simulated read failures.

ci_evidence.performance_evidence: source API call count improves 3 to 2 getters on trusted RT0 only; p95/p99 and FPS NOT_MEASURED
